verdict.rationale: ClickUp ships AI agents, including a Codegen Agent that 'produces quality code', so asking whether an agent can visually verify its own work is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows an agent navigating a running app or capturing before-and-after screenshots. The MCP server and API cover workspace data such as tasks, docs and time tracking, not visual verification of an implementation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
